create_MLP_network: create an MLP neural network with configurable input channels, width, depth, skip connections, and activation functions
load_model_from_checkpoint: load a pretrained model, optimizer, and scheduler state from a checkpoint directory at a specific epoch
save_model_with_optimizer: save a model along with its optimizer and scheduler state to a checkpoint file with progress bar
freeze_unfreeze_module: freeze or unfreeze all parameters of a PyTorch module by setting requires_grad to true or false
take_gradient_jacobian: compute the gradient or jacobian of an output tensor with respect to an input tensor using autograd
